title: Fix Puzzle 3D Fill View Mismatch
description: The puzzle 3D fill tool is buggy: top view and perspective view show different objects when moving the fill amount slider. Both views must always show the same filled objects because they share one scene. Investigate and fix the root cause of the multi-viewport desync (likely revealCutoff / compose_fill_display / per-window interaction state).
summary: Fixed puzzle 3D fill tool desync between top and perspective views. Root cause: fill_count (plus distribution weights and overlap budget) lived in per-window Puzzle3dWindowOptions, so setFillCount only updated the active pane while the other pane kept a stale revealCutoff and a different compose_fill_display applied_count. Moved those fields to app-global Puzzle3dRuntime only; load_window/save_window no longer touch them. Added fill_count_is_shared_across_split_panes_reveal_cutoffs_and_instances. Also unblocked compile by initializing HistoryEdit.backwards in protocol_history decode. All 70 d3::tests passed.
